name: union
comment: Sig union(A,B[,setOrder]). Default 'sorted': union([1 2 3],[3 4 5]) = [1 2 3 4 5]. 'stable': unique(A) in A-order then new-of-B in B-order: union([3 1],[2 1],'stable') = [3 1 2]. COMPLEX (C output only): exact-equality, |z|+angle order: union([1 5i],[3+4i 1])=[1 3+4i 5i], 'stable'=[1 5i 3+4i]. numkit previously IGNORED 'stable' (fixed) and threw on COMPLEX (added 2026-05-29).
